items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I played in the band with Tricky Sam, Bubber Miley, and Sonny Greer

ctx.x: When you were in New York with Seymour and Jeanette?

Yes. We had a date in the Lincoln Theatre - I imagine you've heard of the Lincoln Theatre in Harlem? Duke Ellington had just come into New York with his combo, the Washingtonians they were. They were playing the Lincoln with us because Seymour and Jeanette were the top black act. So he played on stage with the band and they had me in the pit playing with the band. Still couldn't read. I played in the band with Tricky Sam, Bubber Miley, and Sonny Greer, and then I'd go up on stage with the act. I met Fats Waller…
Was he playing the organ just as a solo specialty?
